cobblemon.species.tamatoo.name: Tamatoo
cobblemon.species.tamatoo.desc: A small grass creature that stores sunlight in its shell.
cobblemon.species.flaret.name: Flaret
cobblemon.species.flaret.desc: Its tail flares up whenever it gets excited.
cobblemon.species.cubble.name: Cubble
cobblemon.species.cubble.desc: It blows bubbles that float it gently along.
cobblemon.species.terradua.name: Terradua
cobblemon.species.terradua.desc: Rock plates have grown over its back.
cobblemon.species.warrpen.name: Warrpen
cobblemon.species.warrpen.desc: Star-like sparks trail from its mane.
cobblemon.species.popnaut.name: Popnaut
cobblemon.species.popnaut.desc: Its sealed bubble helmet lets it dive without limit.
cobblemon.move.silentdepths.desc: A crushing wave from the deep. It may disable the target's last move.
cobblemon.move.frozenpthew.desc: A frosty spit that hits once for every Pokémon left in the user's party.
cobblemon.move.frozenworld.desc: Whips up a snowy world. Non-Ice Pokémon are hurt, and may freeze over.
cobblemon.move.blighthammer.desc: A poisonous hammer blow. Deals double damage to poisoned targets.
cobblemon.ability.liquidgoldbody.desc: Absorbs Fire-type moves to raise Speed. Gains Speed when burned.
cobblemon.ability.defensesystems.desc: Absorbs Cosmic-type moves to raise Speed.
cobblemon.ability.auroraaura.desc: Takes half damage in hail or snow, and double damage otherwise.
cobblemon.ability.sinkingsand.desc: Always moves last, but hits harder against faster foes.
cobblemon.ability.battlehungry.desc: Taunts and burns foes that use status moves.
cobblemon.ability.grimending.desc: Summons random weather and takes on its type alongside Ghost.
cobblemon.ability.leechingcompanions.des: Heals from poison damage instead of taking it.
cobblemon.species.karmalon.name: Karmalon
cobblemon.species.karmalon.desc: A jungle ambusher that hides in plain sight and reveals its true form only when provoked.
cobblemon.species.galeliadea.name: Galeliadea
cobblemon.species.sedimite.name: Sedimite
cobblemon.species.sedimite.desc: Sedimite, a fakemon from Pokédex Fillers.
cobblemon.species.sedilock.name: Sedilock
cobblemon.species.sedilock.desc: Sedilock, a fakemon from Pokédex Fillers.
cobblemon.move.corruption.desc: A blast of corrupted cosmic energy that hits with great force.
